mainEntity.name: How do I know whether my business is ready for AI-powered prospect research?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI may be useful when you have a repeatable audience, recurring research need, and enough capacity to review results. It is a poor fit when the offer is still undefined, the market is extremely small, the data is sensitive, or every opportunity requires highly customized judgment. A manual pilot can reveal whether repeated patterns exist before you automate them. Run My AI Biz recommends starting with one assistant and expanding only after the workflow proves manageable.
acceptedAnswer.description: You are more ready when you have a defined audience, repeatable qualification criteria, reliable business information, and time to review outputs. Run a small manual or assisted pilot first. If every prospect needs unique judgment or the offer is unclear, automation may be premature.
